                             This is a translucent glaze made with 2% Stain 6021 Red. I did buy my stain from US         On Standard 112 (Left) and Standard
                          Pigment so take that as you will. If you make this glaze with stain purchased directly from      553 (Right)
                       Mason Stain there's a possibility it will look different.                           2% Stain 6021 Red from US Pigments

                    1% stain looks really pretty as well - see pics                                                     Amber Lofty
                                                                                                                          6 days ago

                   We haven't had any issues with this glaze so far. Students have been loving it.


                         You do need the zircopax/ultrox to punch up the color and reduce that weird bubbly
                               effect you sometimes get with some stains. In this recipe it also helps to make the stain
                          appear more pink. So don't leave it out.
